title: Company Base Pattern
description: Illustrative standards-enforcing Pattern: unlike a structural pattern (which pins exactly which nodes must exist via prefixItems/const), this pattern is agnostic about which nodes exist and instead enforces that EVERY node in the target architecture complies with company-node-standard.json, via items + $ref (not prefixItems) — the shape calm.finos.org's own 'Enforcing Standards' tutorial teaches.
